race.comment: BOLD STRIKE (1) settled back in the field and struggled to make ground when resuming over 1300m at Geelong last time. Down a little in grade and this trip is far more suitable. Expect a much better performance. SOUND OF JURA (4) saluted under today's weight at Swan Hill two back then didn't get the longer trip at Kyneton more recently. Five-time winner at the mile from 12 attempts so she is an obvious threat. CAT NOIR (8) made late ground when resuming at Horsham last start and will appreciate the longer journey this afternoon. JUST CALL ME JONNY (2) returns from a lay-off. Progressing well including a win in a Mortlake jump-out. Opened last campaign with a win at Tauranga over 1400m. Include.
